title: Connection Upgrades
description: Learn how Oasis automatically upgrades connections to more secure protocols, enhancing your browsing security and protecting your data during transmission.
content:
Connection upgrades automatically enhance your browsing security by upgrading connections to more secure protocols whenever possible. This feature helps protect your data and ensures you're using the most secure connection available for each website.

Oasis Feature

Oasis includes automatic connection upgrades built on Firefox core technology. This feature enhances your security by automatically upgrading connections to more secure protocols when available.

What are Connection Upgrades?

Connection upgrades automatically enhance the security of your web connections by upgrading from less secure protocols to more secure ones. This happens transparently in the background, ensuring you always use the best available security for each connection.

How It Works

  • Automatically detects available protocols
  • Upgrades to more secure options
  • Maintains connection stability
  • Works transparently in background
  • Enhances security automatically

Security Benefits

  • Stronger encryption protocols
  • Enhanced data protection
  • Improved privacy
  • Better resistance to attacks
  • Automatic security improvements

Types of Connection Upgrades

Oasis can upgrade various types of connections to enhance your security:

1

HTTP to HTTPS

Automatically upgrades insecure HTTP connections to encrypted HTTPS connections when the website supports it, protecting your data from interception.

2

TLS Version Upgrades

Upgrades from older TLS versions (like TLS 1.0 or 1.1) to newer, more secure versions (TLS 1.2 or 1.3) when available.

3

DNS Protocol Upgrades

Upgrades DNS queries to use more secure protocols like DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) or DNS-over-TLS (DoT) when supported.

How Connection Upgrades Work

The connection upgrade process happens automatically and transparently:

1

Protocol Detection

When you connect to a website, Oasis automatically detects what security protocols the server supports and what's currently being used.

2

Security Assessment

The browser evaluates the current connection security and identifies if a more secure protocol is available.

3

Automatic Upgrade

If a more secure protocol is available, Oasis automatically upgrades the connection without interrupting your browsing experience.

Security Protocol Hierarchy

Web Connections (HTTP/HTTPS)

  • HTTP (Least Secure): Plain text transmission, vulnerable to interception
  • HTTPS (More Secure): Encrypted transmission, protects data
  • HTTPS with HSTS (Most Secure): Forces HTTPS and prevents downgrade attacks

TLS Protocol Versions

  • TLS 1.0/1.1 (Older): Less secure, vulnerable to attacks
  • TLS 1.2 (Better): More secure, widely supported
  • TLS 1.3 (Best): Most secure, fastest, latest standard

DNS Security

  • Standard DNS (Insecure): Plain text queries, vulnerable to interception
  • DNS-over-HTTPS (Secure): Encrypted DNS queries
  • DNS-over-TLS (Secure): Alternative encrypted DNS method

Benefits of Connection Upgrades

Security Enhancements

  • Stronger encryption algorithms
  • Better protection against attacks
  • Reduced vulnerability to interception
  • Enhanced privacy protection
  • Improved resistance to tampering

Performance Improvements

  • Faster connection establishment
  • Reduced latency with newer protocols
  • Better connection efficiency
  • Improved browsing speed
  • Enhanced user experience

Automatic vs Manual Upgrades

Automatic Upgrades

  • Happen transparently in background
  • No user intervention required
  • Always use best available security
  • Seamless user experience
  • Consistent security improvements

Manual Configuration

  • User can configure specific settings
  • Customize upgrade preferences
  • Set security requirements
  • Override automatic behavior
  • Advanced user control

Connection Upgrade Scenarios

Website Access

  • HTTP sites automatically upgraded to HTTPS
  • Older TLS versions upgraded to newer ones
  • Mixed content issues resolved
  • Security warnings reduced
  • Enhanced browsing experience

DNS Resolution

  • Standard DNS upgraded to encrypted DNS
  • DNS queries protected from interception
  • Improved privacy for domain lookups
  • Better resistance to DNS attacks
  • Enhanced overall security

API and Service Connections

  • Backend service connections upgraded
  • API calls use secure protocols
  • Data transmission protected
  • Service integration enhanced
  • Overall system security improved

Configuration Options

Automatic Settings

  • Enable automatic connection upgrades
  • Configure upgrade preferences
  • Set security requirements
  • Choose upgrade strategies
  • Manage fallback behavior

Advanced Configuration

  • Customize protocol preferences
  • Set minimum security levels
  • Configure upgrade timeouts
  • Manage connection pooling
  • Set up monitoring and logging

Monitoring and Verification

Connection Status

  • Check current protocol being used
  • Verify upgrade success
  • Monitor connection quality
  • Track security improvements
  • Identify upgrade failures

Security Indicators

  • Browser security badges
  • Connection protocol indicators
  • Security level displays
  • Upgrade status notifications
  • Security warning messages

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

  • Upgrades not happening automatically
  • Connection failures after upgrades
  • Performance issues with upgrades
  • Compatibility problems
  • Security warnings still appearing

Solutions

  • Check upgrade settings and preferences
  • Update browser to latest version
  • Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Verify website protocol support
  • Contact website administrators

Best Practices

Security Recommendations

  • Always enable automatic upgrades
  • Use minimum TLS 1.2 requirement
  • Enable DNS-over-HTTPS
  • Regularly update browser
  • Monitor connection security

User Guidelines

  • Trust automatic upgrade decisions
  • Pay attention to security indicators
  • Report upgrade failures
  • Use supported browsers
  • Keep systems updated

What to Expect

When using connection upgrades, you may experience:

Security Benefits

  • Enhanced data protection
  • Improved privacy
  • Better resistance to attacks
  • Stronger encryption
  • Reduced security risks

User Experience

  • Seamless automatic upgrades
  • Improved browsing performance
  • Fewer security warnings
  • Better connection stability
  • Enhanced overall experience

Getting Help

For detailed instructions on connection upgrades and security protocol management, visit Mozilla's official support guide:

Mozilla Connection Upgrades Guide

Technical Details

Connection upgrades use advanced networking and security technologies:

How Connection Upgrades Work

  • Protocol Negotiation: Automatically negotiates the best available security protocol
  • Seamless Transition: Upgrades connections without interrupting user experience
  • Fallback Handling: Gracefully handles cases where upgrades aren't available
  • Performance Optimization: Balances security with connection speed
  • Compatibility Management: Ensures upgrades work with various server configurations

Since Oasis is built on Firefox core technology, connection upgrades provide the same robust security enhancements with automatic protocol optimization and seamless user experience.
